notes.heading: Before you go in: human remains
notes.text: This room holds records about people who died long ago, and about how their bodies were cared for after death. The records concern real people and real communities, and some of the dead have living descendants. Some visitors find this hard. You can go in now, or step back to the Cold Store and come back later. Nothing is lost.
